subject: FY 2023 Budget Recommendations
overview: The committee met to align on budgetary requests for the upcoming fiscal year, identifying five consensus priorities for the city administration. Councilors focused on addressing staffing shortages in legal, public works, and code enforcement departments while seeking funding for zoning reform and elections management.

items.title: Joint Budget Proposals for FY 2023
items.summary: Approved five priority budget recommendations—including funding for an assistant city solicitor, a zoning consultant, an elections director, a code enforcement officer, and increased public works staffing—and referred a full report of additional councilor priorities to the administration. Councilor discussion emphasized the need for a united legislative front to ensure specific staffing and infrastructure needs are met in the final executive budget.

items.title: Meeting Cancellation
items.summary: Approved a motion to cancel the committee meeting scheduled for the following evening in light of the progress made during this session.
